Material Info In our capacity as the ultimate holding company of Supernet Infrastructure Solutions (Private) limited (the "Purchaser") , we would like to inform you that (i) Mr. Irtaza Zafar Sheikh and (ii) the Board of Directors of Gazpak (Private) Limited ("GPL"), the shareholders of Hallmark Company Limited ("Company") have entered into Share Purchase Agreement dated April 12, 2023 with the Purchaser ("Share Purchase Agreement") for the sale of all of the Companys shares held by Mr. Sheikh and GPL (i.e. collectively 314,220 constituting approximately 62.84% of the issued and paid-up of the Company) ("Proposed Divestment"). The consummation of the Proposed Divestment will be subject to the terms of the Share Purchase Agreement including issuance of public offer , receipt of requisite approvals and conditions of other closing formalities. A disclosure form is attached herewith. We will intimate Pakistan Stock Exchange on conclusion of this Proposed Divestment.
